signature.name: VTask.Monotone
signature.type: {α : Type u} -> {β : Type v} -> [Preorder α] -> [Preorder β] -> (f : α → β) -> Prop

conventions.statement: Every constant function satisfies VTask.Monotone, since for any fixed value c, c ≤ c holds by reflexivity.
conventions.note: Follows from reflexivity of ≤ in any preorder.

conventions.statement: If the domain type α is empty, VTask.Monotone f holds vacuously for any f.
conventions.note: Universal quantification over an empty type is trivially true.

conventions.statement: On a type with the discrete order (where a ≤ b iff a = b), every function satisfies VTask.Monotone because f a ≤ f a holds by reflexivity whenever a = b.
conventions.note: The preorder assumption suffices; no additional structure is needed.
